detailZones.title: Galley upper storage
detailZones.description: Trace the visible upper cabinets, locker edges, shelves, dividers, trim and ceiling finish.

detailZones.title: Oven and beverage equipment
detailZones.description: Inspect the visible oven fronts, beverage maker, coffee carafe, boiler, dispenser and worktop hardware.

detailZones.title: Service trolley banks
detailZones.description: Compare the visible stowed trolleys, doors, handles, latches, drawers, bays, casters and retaining hardware.

detailZones.title: Sink and waste compartment
detailZones.description: Inspect the visible galley sink, faucet, counter, waste compartment, receptacle and lower panel hardware.

detailZones.title: Doorway and curtain
detailZones.description: Trace the visible galley doorway, aircraft door hardware, handrails, sill, curtain and entry liner.

detailZones.title: Cabin-side seating and floor
detailZones.description: Inspect the visible cabin-side seat parts, aisle floor, wall panels, window and galley floor finish.

anchorAudit.rationale: The final 1600 by 900 aircraft-galley photograph was inspected at source and output resolution. It retains 147 independently pointable cabinet, oven, beverage, trolley, sink, doorway and cabin-side parts. Passenger actions, crew actions, food-service outcomes, airline identity, readable labels, power state, temperature and hidden aircraft systems were excluded.
